resourceBoundary.terminate: Only child-owned process group: SIGTERM,5-second cleanup allowance, thenSIGKILL. Clean surviving owned descendants after normal parent exit too.
resourceBoundary.result: Resource exhaustion, interruption or outer deadline remains incomplete evidence; no assertion or internal test deadline changes.
resourceBoundary.admission: Check memory before child launch; do not launch another file if owned live descendants survive cleanup.

diagnosticOverlay: None: complete files at their exact Git revisions. The candidate fixture correction is separately committed; baseline files use untouched original-main bytes. No golden, assertion or internal deadline changes.
scope: Only source-bound complete observed assertions can classify a matching diagnostic. Failed files remain failed; resource/time/interruption outcomes remain incomplete; later assertions after failure gain no credit.

priorCadenceProof.scope: Original keyboard case passed; gamepad case failed at a duplicate Start click before gameplay. This result is not replaced or relabeled.
